title: Document hi function in module docstring
body:
Add a docstring to `orgos/agile/hi.py`:
```python
"""Greeting function.

>>> hi('there')
'hi there'
"""
```
Also mention the function in `README.md` or a new `orgos/agile/README.md` with a one-liner.

**Done when:** `pytest --doctest-modules orgos/agile/hi.py` passes the doctest.

votes.justification: The change is trivial: a small docstring and a one-line README addition with no design or implementation risk. I can write both files and run the doctest in under 10 minutes.
The change is a simple docstring addition with a single-line doctest, requiring minimal test verification. The test run is straightforward with no risk of failures.
This is a trivial doc-only change with no code changes, so secrets exposure risk is near zero. The only review needed is ensuring no accidental secrets are embedded in the docstring.
